justification: Both are relief-carved surfaces bearing human figures and horizontal banding, and A's abstract disc could loosely echo the wheel discs of B's chariots, but that is where correspondence ends. A shows a single frontal, massively schematic anthropomorphic figure whose body is covered with abstract emblems (discs, spirals, curved bands) and no narrative, whereas B shows multiple superposed registers of naturalistically proportioned figures in strict profile procession, walking, holding hands and leading chariots and animals — an entirely different iconographic scheme and figural convention.
